title: automate-changelog-and-onboard-orion-guardian-13b-v1.0-perf-metadata
author: Priya Natarajan
description:
Onboard the new Orion Guardian 13B v1.0 model into the registry and wire up automated performance profile generation and changelog/release-notes automation. Motivation: Orion Guardian is an open checkpoint we intend to offer as a low-latency 13B option in the catalog. This PR adds metadata, perf profiles (baseline + quantized), validation tests, and a small pipeline change to include generated release notes in model releases. The description below is flattened into a single continuous string with checklist, links, and context. Checklist:
- [x] Add model metadata (name, family, architecture, tokenizer info, config reference)
- [x] Add performance profile YAMLs for fp16 and int8 quantized variants
- [x] Add inference validation unit tests (latency and correctness smoke tests)
- [x] Integrate changelog generation step into registry publish workflow
- [x] Update registry index and models.json
- [x] Docs: add console entry and quickstart snippet
Context: Orion Guardian was evaluated by Applied ML (LIN-789) and passed primary evals for generation quality. Perf team provided 95th-percentile latency baselines on both c5g and A10G-backed instances. The changelog automation follows the pattern introduced in pr-214567 and pr-631112: we now generate a release_notes.md from model metadata + performance profile diffs on each registry merge, and attach it to the release payload. Links: Linear: ENG-3492 (model onboarding), ENG-3510 (changelog automation), PM-812 (catalog prioritization). Commits are squashed on merge. Testing notes: CI runs unit tests, model-inference smoke tests (local harness), and perf profile validation scripts. We re-ran flaky perf-job once to stabilize CI with a fixed seed. Merge method: squash and merge.
commits: Add Orion Guardian v1.0 metadata and tokenizer reference
Add fp16 and int8 performance profile YAMLs
Add inference smoke tests for orion-guardian: seed-based generation test + latency assertion
Registry pipeline: include perf-diff step and generate release_notes.md on publish
Docs: console model card and quickstart example
release_notes:
- Onboarded Orion Guardian 13B v1.0
- Added fp16 and int8 performance profiles with baseline latency and throughput numbers
- Automated changelog generation on registry publishes (perf diff + metadata summary)
- Added smoke tests and console model card
review_comments: Marco Alvarez: Left a few nits on the perf YAML semantics — please add the sample input shape and the seed used for perf runs.
Priya Natarajan: Addressed the perf YAML feedback and added input_shape + seed fields. Reran perf validation with seed=42.
Liam Chen: CI looked flaky twice on the perf job; suggest pinning the validation dataset snapshot. Added a note to the changelog-generator to include dataset checksum.
Sofia Patel: Docs look good; small wording suggestion on the quickstart. Approved after nit fixes.
ci_details: inference-smoke: pass (2 retries to stabilize perf job)
notes: This PR follows the established onboarding checklist used by the registry. The changelog-generator is backwards-compatible and gated behind a feature flag (registry.changelog.enabled) which is enabled in production for model releases. We included a dataset checksum in the release payload to make perf diffs auditable.
short_summary: Onboard Orion Guardian 13B v1.0 with performance profiles and add automated changelog generation to the registry publish pipeline.
